replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
Please shoot an email to support@avicus.net with a good reason why you should be unbanned. Also, if the staff discover you log onto Avicus with the account 'SagiTheKidRS', that too will be banned for ban evading and your other account will NOT be unbanned.

Thanks.
